maddeler.e:
أستصح (form X)
# أَسْتَصِحُّ (ʔastaṣiḥḥu) /ʔas.ta.sˤiħ.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# أَسْتَصِحَّ (ʔastaṣiḥḥa) /ʔas.ta.sˤiħ.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# أَسْتَصِحِّ (ʔastaṣiḥḥi) /ʔas.ta.sˤiħ.ħi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
